title: Relative clauses 3: whose/whom/where
subtitle: whose (чей), whom, where (где), the day/the reason …

theory.text: whose = «чей, у которого»; заменяет his/her/their: I know a girl whose father is a pilot. (её отец — пилот). Сравните: a man who knows you (он знает тебя) и a man whose sister knows you (его сестра знает тебя).
Не путайте whose и who's: звучат одинаково, но who's = who is / who has: a friend who's learning Japanese, но a friend whose sister lives in Japan.
whom — официальный вариант who в роли дополнения, особенно после предлога: a person whom I admire, the person to whom I spoke. В обычной речи говорят проще: a person I admire, the person I spoke to.
where и the day / the time / the reason

items: where — о месте: the town where I was born, the cafe where we met.
the day / the year / the last time + придаточное (when/that можно опустить): the day we met, the last time I saw him.
the reason + придаточное (why/that можно опустить): The reason I was late was the traffic.

theory.text: «Девушка, у которой собака потерялась» — это whose, а не who her dog или who's dog: the girl whose dog got lost. И «причина, по которой» — просто the reason (why), без предлогов.

items.ru: Мы помогли женщине, у которой сломалась машина.
en: We helped a woman whose car had broken down.
We helped a woman whose car broke down.

items.ru: Я знаю девушку, чей отец — пилот.
en: I know a girl whose father is a pilot.
I know a girl whose dad is a pilot.

items.ru: Я познакомился с женщиной, которая работает с твоим братом.
en: I met a woman who works with your brother.
I met a woman that works with your brother.

items.ru: Я познакомился с женщиной, чей брат работает с тобой.
en: I met a woman whose brother works with you.

items.ru: Как зовут мальчика, у которого украли сумку?
en: What's the name of the boy whose bag was stolen?
What's the name of the boy whose bag has been stolen?

items.ru: У меня есть друг, чья сестра живёт в Японии.
en: I have a friend whose sister lives in Japan.
I've got a friend whose sister lives in Japan.

items.ru: У меня есть подруга, которая учит японский.
en: I have a friend who's learning Japanese.
I've got a friend who's learning Japanese.
I have a friend who studies Japanese.
I have a friend who is studying Japanese.

items.ru: Это человек, чью машину мы купили.
en: This is the man whose car we bought.
That's the man whose car we bought.
This is the person whose car we bought.

items.ru: (официально) Это человек, которым я очень восхищаюсь.
en: This is a person whom I admire very much.
This is a person who I admire very much.
This is a person I admire very much.
This is someone whom I admire very much.
This is someone I admire very much.

items.ru: (официально) Человек, с которым я говорил, был очень вежлив.
en: The person to whom I spoke was very polite.
The person with whom I spoke was very polite.
The person I spoke to was very polite.
The person who I spoke to was very polite.

items.ru: (разговорно) Это девушка, в которую влюблён Бен.
en: This is the girl Ben is in love with.
This is the girl who Ben is in love with.
This is the girl that Ben is in love with.
That's the girl Ben is in love with.

items.ru: Это город, где я родился.
en: This is the town where I was born.
This is the city where I was born.
This is the town I was born in.

items.ru: Ресторан, где мы ужинали, был очень дорогим.
en: The restaurant where we had dinner was very expensive.
The restaurant where we had dinner was really expensive.
The restaurant we had dinner in was very expensive.

items.ru: Я бы хотел жить там, где тепло.
en: I'd like to live in a place where it's warm.
I'd like to live somewhere where it's warm.
I want to live in a place where it's warm.

items.ru: Это кафе, где я познакомился с Сарой.
en: This is the cafe where I met Sarah.
That's the cafe where I met Sarah.

items.ru: Ты помнишь день, когда мы познакомились?
en: Do you remember the day we met?
Do you remember the day when we met?
Do you remember the day that we met?
Do you remember the day we first met?

items.ru: Понедельник — это день, когда я работаю допоздна.
en: Monday is the day I work late.
Monday is the day when I work late.
Monday is the day that I work late.

items.ru: В последний раз, когда я видел Тома, он был очень худым.
en: The last time I saw Tom, he was very thin.
The last time that I saw Tom, he was very thin.
The last time when I saw Tom, he was very thin.

items.ru: Это был год, когда я переехал в Лондон.
en: That was the year I moved to London.
That was the year when I moved to London.
That was the year that I moved to London.

items.ru: Причина, по которой я опоздал, — пробки.
en: The reason I was late was the traffic.
The reason why I was late was the traffic.
The reason that I was late was the traffic.
The reason I was late was traffic.

items.ru: Ты знаешь причину, по которой она уволилась?
en: Do you know the reason she left?
Do you know the reason why she left?
Do you know the reason that she left?
Do you know the reason she quit?
Do you know the reason why she quit?

items.ru: Я позвонил человеку, чей номер ты мне дал.
en: I called the man whose number you gave me.
I phoned the man whose number you gave me.
I called the person whose number you gave me.
I phoned the person whose number you gave me.

items.ru: Это отель, в котором остановились мои родители.
en: This is the hotel where my parents are staying.
This is the hotel where my parents stayed.
This is the hotel my parents are staying at.
This is the hotel my parents stayed at.

items.ru: Девочка, у которой потерялась собака, плакала.
en: The girl whose dog got lost was crying.
The girl whose dog was lost was crying.
The girl whose dog had got lost was crying.
